patterns.note: Each portfolio project is presented as a distinct visual module, often with its own background color or unique graphic style, creating a diverse showcase within a unified scroll.
A classic serif font is used for the primary introductory text, lending an editorial and sophisticated feel, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for project titles and labels.
The site uses a high-contrast dark background for the hero and some project sections, punctuated by vibrant, often gradient-filled, accent colors and full-bleed project visuals.
The initial 3D moon graphic in the hero section remains sticky or parallaxes subtly against the scrolling text, creating depth, before eventually scrolling out of view to reveal content sections.

Portfolio projects are clearly delineated by full-width sections that often feature contrasting background colors or distinct visual treatments, making each project feel like a self-contained experience.

technique_notes: The hero features a WebGL-rendered 3D moon graphic that is positioned to appear sticky or parallax slightly as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic foreground-background relationship with the introductory text.
Sections are revealed as the user scrolls, with some projects incorporating a video hero element that auto-plays to showcase motion design work.
The site uses CSS keyframes for subtle animations, such as the colored underlines on specific words in the hero text, adding a playful and interactive touch.

design_tokens.type_scale: The introductory text uses a comfortable, medium-large serif font, while project titles are a distinct, slightly smaller sans-serif, creating a balanced hierarchy without extreme size differences.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners for structural elements and content blocks, with some subtle rounding on internal graphic elements and icons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in the hero section, transitioning to a balanced density for project showcases, allowing visuals ample room to breathe.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its interactive 3D moon hero, which immediately establishes a unique and engaging experience. Beyond that, the portfolio stands out by showcasing an exceptional breadth of design styles and techniques across its projects, demonstrating remarkable versatility rather than adhering to a single aesthetic.
